description: S0: why a stage entered through its zone-title screen flashes black and Level Select does not (source reading of final V1/T1 03db5e1c + POC-SOURCE MODEL of the start fall). Mechanism is established from source; the order the player perceives is not observed.

routes.zone_title: results/title phases -> loader_black -> chaosResultsIncoming=true -> room_goto -> zone Create: level_in armed AND OBJ_effect_fade_in created -> first Draw captures the frame and deactivates all instances (fade object frozen at alpha 0.95) -> 19 updates of the captured frame through black, 1/3, 2/3 -> update 20: everything resumes, fade object continues from 0.95 over the live level
routes.death_respawn: same handoff (SCR_chaos_death.gml:43): the same flash is predicted after a respawn
routes.level_select: chaos_debug_launch -> room_goto: only OBJ_effect_fade_in, running from update 1 (alpha 1 -> 0 in 20 steps, gameplay live): monotone fade, no dip
routes.data_select_start: legacy fade_out (alpha +0.07) then room_goto: same as Level Select on arrival

predicted_brightness.zone_title: 0 for updates 1-9; 1/3 (10-14); 2/3 (15-19); then ~0.05 at update 20-21 (dip); then linear to 1.0 by update ~40
predicted_brightness.level_select: alpha 0.95 at update 1 falling 0.05 per update: monotone to 1.0 by update 20

rom_reference.GPZ1_MGHZ1: player state 14 from frame 30, +14 px over frames 30-37, floor contact frame 39-40: the drop is mostly under black/the dimmest step
rom_reference.THZ1: no drop; 7 px anchor flicker 654/661 in frames 35-38 under the first dim step (T2-11)

poc_only_exposure: gameplay is frozen for the 19 level_in updates (deactivate_all) - the ROM runs the player during its fade
the fall therefore happens after the freeze, under the resumed fade object (alpha 0.95..), instead of under black
the resumed fade object adds a second fade on top of the finished SMS-style fade (dip to ~0.05)

capture.rows: first 90 Draw events after Room Start, one file per entry
capture.confirms: in the zone-title and respawn routes: fade_exists flips false at update 1-2 and true at results_age 20 with fade_alpha 0.90-0.95, lum drops by > 0.25 within 2 updates of that release; the Level Select routes show lum monotone

anchors.why: first statement of every ordinary-act room start
armed only when global.chaosResultsIncoming was set before the room change
legacy black fade object, created unconditionally, after the level_in arming
20 steps to clear; it is a Step-driven object, not time based
first level_in Draw: captures application_surface, then freezes every instance except the controls (the fade object included)
draws the captured frame through the SMS-style in_black steps: 0 (black), 1/3, 2/3 at ages 1-9, 10-14, 15-19
age 20: instance_activate_all(): player, zone, ring manager AND the frozen fade object resume
end of the zone-title / loader_black phase: sets the flag, then room_goto(next act)
death / continue respawn uses the same handoff
Level Select: no flag, so no level_in and no freeze
Data Select START: legacy fade_out then room_goto, no flag
controls (depth -10000) draw the capture above the level and below the fade object (depth -999999)
